alkylation reagent: free sulfhydryl groups were carbamidomethylated using 30 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
alkylation concentration: free sulfhydryl groups were carbamidomethylated using 30 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
cleavage agent: Trypsin (Promega, sequencing grade) was added at a ratio of 1:30 and incubated at 37 °C for 12 h.
collision energy: the 20 most intense signals above an intensity threshold of 104 and with charge states 2–5 were subjected to collision induced dissociation in the ion trap with a normalized collision energy of 35%
enrichment method: Separation of the three protein classes was achieved by either (i) carbonate treatment at pH 11.5 to separate integral membrane proteins
fractionation method: Samples were resuspended in 10 mM KH2PO4 (pH 2.7) and fractionated using strong cation exchange chromatography (SCX).
fragmentation method: the 20 most intense signals above an intensity threshold of 104 and with charge states 2–5 were subjected to collision induced dissociation in the ion trap
instrument: Nano-LC-MS/MS was performed on an LTQ-Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer coupled to an Ultimate 3000 RSLC
labeling: We used stable isotope labeled yeast cultures (SILAC) and isolated highly pure light and heavy mitochondria
reduction reagent: Cysteines were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 30 min at 56 °C
reduction concentration: Cysteines were reduced with 10 mM DTT for 30 min at 56 °C
